index.title: Welcome to {brand}.
index.intro: A few choices and we'll boot the rest of your install. You can change everything later from {location}.

mode.title: Operating mode
mode.desc: Pick a starting point — IMAP-only, marketing, full suite…

email.title: Email provider
email.desc: Owlat MTA, Resend, Amazon SES, or none.

index.laterNote: AI providers, integrations, and your sending domain + DKIM are configured afterwards from {settings}.

mode.title: How will you run {brand}?
mode.intro: Pick the closest mode to pre-fill your features — you can fine-tune everything on the next step. See {docsLink} for the full matrix.
mode.migrationLegend: Are you moving from another platform, or starting fresh on Owlat?
mode.freshDesc: Owlat is our home. No import needed.
mode.migratingDesc: We'll offer new users a mail import at first login.

features.title: Pick what to {accent}
features.intro: Toggle a master feature off and its sub-features disable automatically. You can change all of this later.
features.providerRequiredTitle: A delivery provider is required next
features.providerRequiredMessage: Campaigns, transactional, or automations are enabled — the Email step will require a delivery provider (MTA, Resend, or SES). A connected external mailbox is not one.
features.packsIntro: Pick a bundle. Toggling a pack flips every flag it contains.

email.title: How should Owlat send {accent}?
email.intro: Three honest ways to send: run your own mail server for full control, hand delivery to Amazon SES, or relay through an SMTP provider you already pay for.
email.providerRequiredMessage: You enabled campaigns, transactional, or automations — these send through a delivery provider, so one is required.
email.providerOptionalMessage: No bulk sending is enabled. Note that system/auth emails (password reset, invitations) still need a transport.

mta.label: Run your own MTA
mta.hint: Full control, no third party. Needs port 25 open and a clean sending IP, plus your sending domain + DKIM.

ses.label: Amazon SES
ses.hint: Managed deliverability, cheap at scale. Needs an AWS account.

smtp.label: SMTP relay
smtp.hint: Bring the provider you already pay for — Mailgun, Postmark, SendGrid, Brevo, or any custom SMTP server.

resend.label: Resend
resend.hint: Managed API with a generous free tier. Great developer experience.

mandrill.label: Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill)
mandrill.hint: Coming from Mailchimp? Keep the sending reputation you already have, then move onto your own MTA at your own pace.

emailit.label: Emailit
emailit.hint: Managed email API with signed delivery feedback and idempotent sends.

none.label: No delivery provider (receive-only / IMAP-only)
none.hint: Read external mailboxes; no marketing or transactional. System/auth email still needs a transport.

email.mandrillHint: Mailchimp Transactional → Settings → API keys. Bounce and complaint feedback needs a webhook too — Delivery → Provider has the URL and the events to enable once setup is done.
email.smtpPresetHint: Prefills the server, port, and encryption. Pick Custom for any other SMTP server.
email.smtpHostHelp: The relay handles delivery, so authentication (SPF/DKIM) is set up on the relay's side, not Owlat's.
email.smtpSecureLabel: Implicit TLS (port 465). Leave off for STARTTLS on 587.
email.mtaIdentityIntro: The MTA profile is enabled. Enter the public source IPs and the hostname their PTR records resolve to before launch.
email.campaignIpsHelp: May repeat a transactional IP for a single-IP deployment.
email.ehloHostnameHelp: Set each IP PTR exactly to its EHLO hostname, then point that hostname back to the IP.
email.ehloOverridesHelp: Use when different source IPs have different PTR hostnames.
email.setupTokenHelp: Printed by the owlat setup command when it enabled setup mode. Required to verify the provider and launch.
email.fromIdentityIntro: The default From address for system mail. Leave blank to derive it from your sending domain later.
email.fromAddressHelp: We'll use this for password resets, invitations, and double opt-in.

errors.missingToken: Enter the setup token printed by `owlat setup` to verify the provider, then try again.
errors.validationFailed: Could not validate the provider. Try again.

admin.title: {accent} account
admin.intro: The first user. You can invite teammates from the dashboard after launch.

review.title: Review & {accent}
review.intro: Last chance to change anything. You can also flip toggles from Settings → Features after launch.
review.mailboxImportEnabled: Enabled — new users can import mail from your old platform at first login.
review.setupTokenHelp: Printed by the owlat setup command when it enabled setup mode. Required to launch — it proves you're the operator who started setup.
review.missingProviderMessage: Campaigns, transactional, or automations are enabled but no delivery provider is configured. Go back to the Email step and choose MTA, Resend, or SES.
review.appliedMessage: Finishing up — the app is loading your configuration, then we'll take you to sign in. This usually takes a few seconds.
review.restartTimeout: On a managed install this finishes on its own. If you're running a manual {command} stack, restart the web container — we'll continue automatically the moment it's back.
review.errorUnknown: Setup failed for an unknown reason.
